2026-CKDA.caption_en: Token projections produce signed decay and write gates for a recurrent state, whose query readout passes through gated normalization.
2026-CKDA.caption_zh: 令牌投影生成带符号的衰减和写入门，查询读出递推状态，再经门控归一化与投影。

2025-Kimi-Delta-Attention.caption_en: For each token, decay the stored state by channel, write the gated value residual, and read the updated state with the query.
2025-Kimi-Delta-Attention.caption_zh: 每步按通道衰减记忆，把门控后的值残差写入状态，再用查询读出更新后的状态。

2024-Gated-Slot-Attention.caption_en: Tokens update separate key and value states for each slot, then query scores select a weighted mixture of slot values.
2024-Gated-Slot-Attention.caption_zh: 令牌分别更新各槽的键和值状态，查询给槽打分，再按权重混合槽中的值。

2023-Qwen-VL-Resampler.caption_en: Learned grid queries read visual tokens through cross attention, with bicubic interpolation aligning the key positions to the input grid.
2023-Qwen-VL-Resampler.caption_zh: 可学习的网格查询通过交叉注意力读出视觉令牌，键的位置编码经双三次插值对齐输入网格。

2019-Adaptively-Sparse-Transformer.caption_en: Scores and a supplied alpha set a threshold by bisection, then positive parts become sparse attention weights.
2019-Adaptively-Sparse-Transformer.caption_zh: 分数和给定的 α 经二分法求出阈值，截去负值后生成稀疏注意力权重。

2026-BIM.caption_en: Two depthwise convolutions form features at different scales, whose channel similarities set the weights for a sequence of feature products.
2026-BIM.caption_zh: 两路深度卷积提取不同尺度的特征，通道相似度给两路特征加权，随后逐级相乘并投影。

2026-D-AAttn.caption_en: Learned offsets resample queries, keys and values before local window attention, and a depthwise value projection adds positional information.
2026-D-AAttn.caption_zh: 学习出的偏移重采样查询、键和值，再做局部窗口注意力，最后叠加值的深度卷积位置特征。

2026-HA.caption_en: A channel gate weights convolved features and a spatial gate weights the input, then the module adds both maps.
2026-HA.caption_zh: 通道门给卷积特征加权，空间门给原始特征加权，两路结果相加。

2026-MSE.caption_en: The normalized input feeds a depthwise convolution and a channel gate, then their feature maps multiply before the residual addition.
2026-MSE.caption_zh: 归一化特征进入深度卷积和通道门，两路特征逐点相乘，再加回输入。

2026-RSWAttention.caption_en: Each window mixes channels with dot product weights, then a linear map over its value positions gates the result before reassembly.
2026-RSWAttention.caption_zh: 每个窗口用点积权重混合通道，再用值的位置线性映射门控结果，最后拼回特征图。

2026-SGA.caption_en: Two projected maps supply a shared mean for Gaussian scoring, then their gated residuals are concatenated and refined by convolutions.
2026-SGA.caption_zh: 两路投影特征提供共享均值，高斯打分为每路加权，再拼接带残差的结果并卷积。

2025-AttentionGate.caption_en: The gating and skip maps are projected and added to predict a spatial mask, which scales the original skip features.
2025-AttentionGate.caption_zh: 门控特征和跳接特征投影后相加，生成空间权重，再给原始跳接特征加权。

2025-Di-SpAM.caption_en: Parallel dilated filters are summed, gated and reweighted by pooled channels, then projected and added back to the input.
2025-Di-SpAM.caption_zh: 多路空洞卷积相加，通道分半相乘，再用池化得到的权重重标定，最后投影并加回输入。

2025-GSA-Gauss.caption_en: Channel pooling finds a peak that sets a Gaussian center, and the normalized Gaussian map weights the input.
2025-GSA-Gauss.caption_zh: 通道池化找到峰值位置，据此设置高斯中心，归一化后的高斯图给原输入加权。

2025-LWGA.caption_en: Four channel groups use point, local, directional and global operations, then their concatenation is projected and added to the input.
2025-LWGA.caption_zh: 四组通道分别做逐点门控、局部卷积、方向门控和全局注意力，再拼接、投影并加回输入。

2025-RCSSC.caption_en: Spatial and column gates weight shared features, then a pooled context gate modulates their fusion before the residual addition.
2025-RCSSC.caption_zh: 空间门和列方向门给共享特征加权，池化上下文再调节融合结果，最后加回输入。

2024-CAA.caption_en: Local average pooling and two depthwise strip convolutions build a sigmoid mask that weights the original feature map.
2024-CAA.caption_zh: 局部平均池化和两次深度条形卷积生成权重图，再逐点乘回原始特征。

2024-KEP-SVGP.caption_en: Low rank query and key scores parameterize a Gaussian posterior whose samples are projected into output tokens.
2024-KEP-SVGP.caption_zh: 低秩查询和键分数决定高斯后验，从后验采样后投影成输出令牌。

2023-CloMSFM.caption_en: Local heads gate convolved values, while global heads read pooled tokens, then the module fuses both outputs with a residual.
2023-CloMSFM.caption_zh: 局部头门控卷积后的值，全局头读取池化令牌，两路输出拼接投影后加回输入。

2022-FLASH-GAU.caption_en: Tokens combine within chunk attention with summaries across chunks, then gate and project the result before adding the input.
2022-FLASH-GAU.caption_zh: 令牌合并块内注意力与跨块摘要，再经门控和投影后加回输入。

2026-Clipped-RoPE.caption_en: A cosine taper attenuates the lowest rotary frequencies before their sine and cosine rotate the queries and keys.
2026-Clipped-RoPE.caption_zh: 模块用余弦窗衰减最低的旋转频率，再用所得正弦和余弦旋转查询与键。

2026-ConvNeur.caption_en: A global neural memory reads chunkwise updates to gate local convolution features, then the block adds the original input.
2026-ConvNeur.caption_zh: 全局神经记忆读取按块更新的状态，为局部卷积特征生成门控，再加回输入。

2026-Gated-DeltaNet-2.caption_en: Each token decays the memory, uses separate gates for erasure and writing, and reads the updated state through its query.
2026-Gated-DeltaNet-2.caption_zh: 每个词元先衰减记忆，再用不同的门擦除和写入，最后用查询读取更新后的状态。

2026-Softpick.caption_en: Causal query–key scores become nonnegative weights through rectification and absolute-sum normalization, then those weights mix the values.
2026-Softpick.caption_zh: 模块整流因果打分，并按绝对值和归一化，再用所得非负权重混合值。

2025-DAPE-V2.caption_en: Two convolutions process masked scores and position bias, then add the learned correction and the position bias to the original scores.
2025-DAPE-V2.caption_zh: 模块对掩蔽后的打分和位置偏置做两层卷积，再把学习到的修正量与位置偏置加回原打分。

2025-DeltaProduct.caption_en: Several key–value updates modify the state for each token, and the query reads only the last updated state.
2025-DeltaProduct.caption_zh: 每个词元用多组键和值连续更新状态，查询只读取最后一次更新后的状态。

2025-Double-Sparsity.caption_en: Selected channels rank the causal prefix, then full-width scores over the retained keys determine how to mix their values.
2025-Double-Sparsity.caption_zh: 模块先用选定通道为因果前缀排序，再用保留键的全通道打分决定如何混合对应的值。

2025-FlexPrefill.caption_en: A probe of the last query block selects a causal block pattern per head, and masked attention mixes values within that pattern.
2025-FlexPrefill.caption_zh: 模块用最后一个查询块为每个头选出因果块模式，再在选中的块内混合值。

2025-Gated-DeltaNet.caption_en: Each token decays the previous state, writes a gated key–value correction, and reads the updated state through its query.
2025-Gated-DeltaNet.caption_zh: 每个词元先衰减上一步状态，再写入带门控的键值修正，最后用查询读取更新后的状态。

2025-Gemma-3-Local-Global-Attention.caption_en: The layer selects local or global rotary settings and masking, then uses normalized queries and keys to mix values.
2025-Gemma-3-Local-Global-Attention.caption_zh: 该层按配置选择局部或全局旋转参数和掩码，再用归一化后的查询和键计算权重并混合值。

2025-LongRoPE2.caption_en: The maximum position selects a short or long frequency scale before the module returns rotary cosine and sine factors.
2025-LongRoPE2.caption_zh: 模块按最大位置选用短程或长程频率系数，再返回旋转所需的余弦和正弦。

2025-nGPT-Attention.caption_en: Rotary queries and keys receive unit normalization and learned scales, then the attention result moves the residual toward a new unit vector.
2025-nGPT-Attention.caption_zh: 模块将旋转后的查询和键单位化并学习缩放，再用注意力结果更新残差，最后恢复单位长度。

2025-OLMo-2-QK-Norm-Attention.caption_en: RMSNorm spans each projected query and key before head splitting and rotation, then grouped attention mixes values.
2025-OLMo-2-QK-Norm-Attention.caption_zh: 模块先在拆头前归一化查询与键的投影，再旋转查询与键，并通过分组注意力混合值。

2025-SigmoidAttn.caption_en: Image tokens form scaled and biased query–key scores, and sigmoid weights mix the values before the spatial grid is restored.
2025-SigmoidAttn.caption_zh: 图像词元生成缩放并加偏置的打分，再用 Sigmoid 权重混合值并恢复空间网格。

2025-TAPNext-Per-Frame-Point-Attention.caption_en: Patch and point tokens attend to one another within each frame, then residual attention and MLP updates preserve the original frame layout.
2025-TAPNext-Per-Frame-Point-Attention.caption_zh: 图块词元和点词元在同一帧内互相注意，经过残差注意力和 MLP 更新后恢复原有帧布局。

2024-CogVLM-Visual-Expert.caption_en: Token types route the input and output projections through visual or language experts while both streams share one attention operation.
2024-CogVLM-Visual-Expert.caption_zh: 词元类型决定输入和输出使用视觉专家还是语言专家，两类词元共用一次注意力计算。

2024-CPAM.caption_en: Channel weights filter the first feature map before fusion, then height and width gates rescale the fused map.
2024-CPAM.caption_zh: 模块先用通道权重筛选第一路特征并与第二路相加，再用高度与宽度门控缩放融合特征。

2024-DAPE.caption_en: A position bias and input scores feed a shared pairwise MLP, whose correction joins both terms in the returned scores.
2024-DAPE.caption_zh: 位置偏置和原打分进入逐位置对的 MLP，所得修正量与两项相加，得到调整后的打分。

2024-DeltaNet.caption_en: The key first reads a value from memory, then a gated prediction error updates the state before the query reads it.
2024-DeltaNet.caption_zh: 键先从记忆中读出预测值，再用带门控的预测误差更新状态，最后由查询读取。

2024-Falcon-Mamba.caption_en: A causal convolution supplies selective state updates and normalized readout parameters, then a SiLU gate filters the resulting sequence.
2024-Falcon-Mamba.caption_zh: 因果卷积提供选择性状态更新所需的输入和归一化读出参数，再用 SiLU 门过滤读出序列。

2024-Gemma-2-Soft-capped-Attention.caption_en: Grouped attention rotates queries and keys, bounds their logits with tanh, then masks and normalizes the scores before mixing values.
2024-Gemma-2-Soft-capped-Attention.caption_zh: 分组注意力先旋转查询和键，再用 Tanh 限制打分，随后加掩码、归一化并混合值。

2024-GLA.caption_en: A key-channel gate decays the state before adding the current key–value product, and the query reads the result.
2024-GLA.caption_zh: 键通道门先衰减状态，再加上当前键和值的外积，最后由查询读取新状态。

2024-Kosmos-2-Resampler.caption_en: Learned queries attend to projected image tokens and to themselves, producing a fixed number of output tokens.
2024-Kosmos-2-Resampler.caption_zh: 可学习查询同时读取投影后的图像词元和查询词元，输出固定数量的词元。

2024-LlamaGen-Visual-GQA.caption_en: Image token queries and keys receive two-dimensional rotary factors, and query groups share keys and values during causal attention.
2024-LlamaGen-Visual-GQA.caption_zh: 图像词元的查询与键应用二维旋转因子，多组查询在因果注意力中共享键和值。

2024-MinGRU.caption_en: A projected gate blends the previous state with a positive candidate, then a linear layer projects the recurrent sequence back.
2024-MinGRU.caption_zh: 投影得到的门在前一状态和正值候选之间插值，再由线性层投影递推序列。

2024-ReBased.caption_en: Normalized queries and keys form squared causal scores, and dividing their value sum by the score sum returns the context.
2024-ReBased.caption_zh: 归一化后的查询和键生成平方因果打分，模块用打分加权求和值，再除以打分和。

2024-SD3-MMDiT-Joint-Attention.caption_en: Image and text tokens use separate projections, share attention after concatenation, and split back into two gated residual streams.
2024-SD3-MMDiT-Joint-Attention.caption_zh: 图像和文本词元分别投影，拼接后共享注意力，再拆回两路并做门控残差更新。

2024-SparQ-Attention.caption_en: Large query channels rank candidate keys, then full-width attention mixes selected values and can assign leftover weight to their prefix mean.
2024-SparQ-Attention.caption_zh: 模块用幅值较大的查询通道给候选键排序，再用全通道注意力混合入选的值，并可把剩余权重分给前缀均值。

2023-E-Branchformer.caption_en: Relative attention and a convolutional gate process the same sequence, then depthwise fusion joins their outputs in a residual update.
2023-E-Branchformer.caption_zh: 相对位置注意力和卷积门控处理同一序列，再用深度卷积融合两路输出并更新残差。

2023-EMA.caption_en: Two grouped feature paths score one another, and their combined spatial weights rescale each group before the channels are restored.
2023-EMA.caption_zh: 两条分组特征路径互相打分，合成空间权重后缩放各组特征，再恢复原通道排列。

2023-Swin3D-Contextual-Relative-Attentio.caption_en: Within each sparse voxel window, relative lookup vectors modify query–key scores and values before the weighted result returns to voxel order.
2023-Swin3D-Contextual-Relative-Attentio.caption_zh: 模块在每个稀疏体素窗口内用相对位置查表向量修正打分和值，再按原体素顺序返回加权结果。

2022-GLIP.caption_en: One image–text score matrix normalizes along both token axes so each stream can mix values from the other.
2022-GLIP.caption_zh: 同一张图文打分矩阵分别沿文本轴和图像轴归一化，让两路词元互相读取对方的值。

2022-SAT-Graph-Transformer.caption_en: Graph neighborhoods shape query and key projections, while values come directly from the nodes and mix across each graph.
2022-SAT-Graph-Transformer.caption_zh: 图邻域产生查询和键所需的结构特征，值直接来自原节点，并在各自的图内混合。

2022-StyleSwin-Double-Attention.caption_en: Style-normalized channels split between regular and shifted windows, then the two attention paths rejoin before the residual update.
2022-StyleSwin-Double-Attention.caption_zh: 风格归一化后的通道分赴普通窗口和移位窗口，两路注意力结果合并后再加回残差。

2021-ADM-AttentionBlock.caption_en: Spatial tokens pass through group normalization and self-attention before an output projection and residual restore the feature grid.
2021-ADM-AttentionBlock.caption_zh: 空间词元经过组归一化与自注意力，再做输出投影、加回残差并恢复特征网格。

2021-DeBERTa-Disentangled-Attention.caption_en: Content and relative-position terms add to the attention logits, then masked softmax weights mix the value stream.
2021-DeBERTa-Disentangled-Attention.caption_zh: 内容打分与相对位置打分相加，再用掩码 Softmax 得到的权重混合值。

2020-LinearAttention.caption_en: Mapped keys summarize values and total key mass, then mapped queries read and normalize those summaries without a pairwise score matrix.
2020-LinearAttention.caption_zh: 映射后的键汇总值与键本身，再由映射后的查询读取并归一化这两项。

2020-SMYRF.caption_en: Asymmetric hash sorting creates paired query and key clusters, and each hash round contributes according to its softmax denominator.
2020-SMYRF.caption_zh: 非对称哈希排序把查询簇与键簇配对，再按各轮 Softmax 的分母汇总多轮结果。

2020-T5-Relative-Position-Bias.caption_en: Relative offsets use exact nearby buckets and logarithmic distant buckets, then a table supplies a bias for each head.
2020-T5-Relative-Position-Bias.caption_zh: 模块对近距离逐一分桶，对远距离用对数分桶，再查表生成每个头的位置偏置。

2019-Adaptive-Attention-Span.caption_en: A learned span gives each head a tapered distance mask, then the module optionally renormalizes the masked attention probabilities.
2019-Adaptive-Attention-Span.caption_zh: 每个头按可学习的跨度生成逐渐衰减的距离掩码，应用掩码后可重新归一化注意力概率。

2019-MQA.caption_en: Many query heads use one shared key and value stream, then a linear projection merges their contexts.
2019-MQA.caption_zh: 多个查询头共用一组键和值，再由线性投影合并各头的上下文。

2019-RGAT.caption_en: Relation-specific projections form edge scores, and grouped softmax weights mix source messages at each target node.
2019-RGAT.caption_zh: 关系专属的投影产生边打分，再用分组 Softmax 权重把源节点消息汇入目标节点。

2019-Sparse-Seq2Seq.caption_en: A threshold sets low alignment scores to zero, while the remaining scores form a sparse probability distribution over keys.
2019-Sparse-Seq2Seq.caption_zh: 阈值把较低的对齐打分置零，保留的打分形成键上的稀疏概率分布。

2018-GAT.caption_en: Each head scores graph edges with two projected node terms, then normalizes over neighbors and aggregates their features.
2018-GAT.caption_zh: 每个头用两个节点投影项给边打分，再在邻居间归一化并汇总邻居特征。

2018-PixelSNAIL-Causal-Attention.caption_en: A strict raster mask excludes the current and later pixels, then normalized scores mix the eligible values for each query pixel.
2018-PixelSNAIL-Causal-Attention.caption_zh: 严格的光栅顺序掩码排除当前及之后的像素，再用归一化打分混合每个查询像素可读取的值。

2018-SkipNet.caption_en: A recurrent scalar gate uses pooled block features to decide which samples execute the block and which take its shortcut.
2018-SkipNet.caption_zh: 循环标量门读取池化后的特征，逐样本决定执行当前块还是走捷径。

2017-Structured-Attention-Networks.caption_en: A two-state chain converts query–context scores into edge marginals, whose selected state probabilities weight the context summary.
2017-Structured-Attention-Networks.caption_zh: 二状态链把查询和上下文打分转为边缘概率，再用选定状态的概率加权汇总上下文。

2026-ACE.caption_en: Row and column attention join the value map to form a spatial gate, which multiplies convolutional detail features.
2026-ACE.caption_zh: 行注意力和列注意力与值特征相加，生成空间门控，再乘到卷积细节特征上。

2026-AFEM.caption_en: Channel attention mixes projected values, while Gaussian frequency filtering enhances another path before the two feature maps fuse.
2026-AFEM.caption_zh: 通道注意力混合投影后的值，另一支用高斯频域滤波增强特征，最后合并两路。

2026-ALCA.caption_en: Interleaved mean, max, and deviation statistics produce channel weights, then a spatial gate filters the channel-refined features.
2026-ALCA.caption_zh: 交错排列的均值、最大值和标准差生成通道权重，随后空间门控筛选通道加权后的特征。

2026-BinaryAttention.caption_en: Scaled signs replace queries and keys before scoring, then optional eight-bit quantization prepares the probabilities and values for mixing.
2026-BinaryAttention.caption_zh: 模块用带缩放的二值符号替换查询与键再打分，混合前可将概率和值量化为八位。

2026-BSA.caption_en: One channel half bypasses two patch attention blocks, whose overlapping outputs average back onto the grid before channel fusion.
2026-BSA.caption_zh: 一半通道走捷径，另一半经过两个块内注意力单元，重叠区取平均后再与捷径融合。

2026-CANA.caption_en: Window affinities assign and sort pixels, then overlapping chunks mix same-assignment neighbors before gating and restoring the grid.
2026-CANA.caption_zh: 窗口亲和分数为像素分组并排序，再在重叠块内混合同组邻居，经门控后恢复网格。

2026-CFEM.caption_en: Average and max pools feed separate concatenation and sum paths, whose fused descriptor produces a channel gate for the input.
2026-CFEM.caption_zh: 两种池化结果都进入拼接与求和路径，融合后生成通道门控并重标定输入。

2026-CGILA.caption_en: The block sums four global spatial statistics and turns them into per-channel weights that scale the input features.
2026-CGILA.caption_zh: 模块对每个通道的四种全局空间统计量求和，生成通道权重并缩放输入特征。

2026-CooAtt.caption_en: Pooling along each image axis feeds one shared transform, and two separate gates scale the input across rows and columns.
2026-CooAtt.caption_zh: 模块沿两个图像轴分别池化，经共享变换生成两组门控，再逐行、逐列缩放输入。

2026-CViT.caption_en: Full-resolution queries read reduced keys and values with relative position bias, then two residual steps return the refined grid.
2026-CViT.caption_zh: 全分辨率查询用相对位置偏置读取压缩后的键和值，随后两次残差相加输出特征网格。

2026-CWA.caption_en: A voxelwise softmax weighs two input volumes, then channel attention and squeeze-and-excitation refine the concatenated result.
2026-CWA.caption_zh: 模块用逐体素 Softmax 对两个输入体加权，再对拼接结果做通道注意力和压缩激励。

2026-CWA-2.caption_en: Depthwise convolution gathers spatial context, and a pointwise convolution followed by sigmoid returns one weight per feature-map element.
2026-CWA-2.caption_zh: 深度卷积汇集空间信息，再经逐点卷积和 Sigmoid，为特征图的每个元素生成一个权重。

2026-CWSA.caption_en: Queries and keys score channel pairs across the spatial grid, then the weighted values are projected and added to the input.
2026-CWSA.caption_zh: 查询与键沿空间轴为通道对打分，再将加权后的值投影并加回输入。

2026-DCMM.caption_en: Query memberships and pairwise degree factors form a bias for dot-product scores before softmax mixes the values.
2026-DCMM.caption_zh: 查询的群组隶属度与成对度因子生成打分偏置，随后用 Softmax 权重混合值。

2026-DCSA.caption_en: An input-predicted top-k mask sparsifies channel attention, whose output fuses with a local branch gated by Fourier magnitude.
2026-DCSA.caption_zh: 模块从输入预测 Top-k 稀疏掩码，再将通道注意力结果与傅里叶幅值引导的局部分支融合。

2026-DHOGSA.caption_en: Patch gradients reorder pixels within patches, then value gradients sort tokens for two attention layouts before both orders are restored.
2026-DHOGSA.caption_zh: 图块梯度引导块内像素排序，值的梯度为两种注意力布局排序，随后恢复两次排序前的位置。

2026-DIFF.caption_en: Pixel shuffle expands the grid for two depthwise filters, then a Mish gate and feature decomposition precede pixel unshuffle and projection.
2026-DIFF.caption_zh: 像素重排放大网格供两路深度卷积使用，随后做 Mish 门控和特征分解，再恢复网格并投影。

2026-DMA.caption_en: A center query gates locations while a second center query mixes channels, and the two paths multiply before projection.
2026-DMA.caption_zh: 两个中心查询分别为位置加权和混合通道，两路结果相乘后投影。

2026-DSwin-Attention.caption_en: Query offsets resample the input for neighborhood keys and values, and a depthwise positional branch adds local detail to the result.
2026-DSwin-Attention.caption_zh: 查询预测偏移并重采样输入，生成邻域的键和值，再加上深度卷积提取的局部位置信息。

2026-DWConvAttention.caption_en: A linear projection feeds a depthwise convolution on the patch grid, then a second projection returns tokens.
2026-DWConvAttention.caption_zh: 模块先线性投影，再在图块网格上做深度卷积，最后投影回词元序列。

2026-DWSA.caption_en: Overlapping-window and channel attention join a per-pixel rank-two reconstruction, then the fused grid is cropped and added to the input.
2026-DWSA.caption_zh: 重叠窗口注意力、通道注意力和逐像素秩二重建的结果融合后，裁回原尺寸并加回输入。

2026-EuSA.caption_en: Euclidean distance penalizes spatial scores per head, then the value mixture adds depthwise-convolved values before projection.
2026-EuSA.caption_zh: 模块用欧氏距离衰减每个头的空间打分，将加权值与深度卷积处理后的值相加，再投影。

2026-FilterAttention.caption_en: Multiscale Hessian responses combine into a voxel gate that scales a volume before adding the original input.
2026-FilterAttention.caption_zh: 多尺度 Hessian 响应融合成体素门控，用于缩放体数据，再加回原输入。

2026-HAE.caption_en: Three channel groups take pooling, sequential channel and spatial gates, or depthwise convolution before rejoining for residual convolution and projection.
2026-HAE.caption_zh: 三组通道分别经池化、串行通道与空间门控、深度卷积，再拼接并做残差卷积和投影。

2026-HFA.caption_en: A shared encoder and two decoders predict elementwise weights that blend two feature maps with a two-way softmax.
2026-HFA.caption_zh: 共享编码器和两个解码器预测逐元素权重，再通过双路 Softmax 加权融合两张特征图。

2026-InfSA.caption_en: Rectified scores use either Frobenius normalization or an energy-pooled query to mix values, then a linear layer projects the result.
2026-InfSA.caption_zh: 整流打分可用矩阵范数归一化，或先按能量汇总查询再打分，两条路径各自混合值并投影。

2026-LCA.caption_en: A pointwise convolution makes a gate at every location and channel, and sigmoid weights scale the original features.
2026-LCA.caption_zh: 逐点卷积为每个位置的各通道生成门控，经 Sigmoid 后缩放原特征。

2026-LCGA.caption_en: Each window mixes regular and curvature-modulated attention weights, then the joined window output adds depthwise-filtered values.
2026-LCGA.caption_zh: 每个窗口混合常规权重与曲率调制权重，合并窗口后加上经深度卷积处理的值。

2026-LP.caption_en: A dense convolutional branch builds an importance map, which conditions two refinement stages that both add the initial features.
2026-LP.caption_zh: 密集连接的卷积分支生成重要性图，两次细化都用这张图，并各自加回初始特征。

2026-LSCA.caption_en: Spatial self-attention feeds channel self-attention, whose value projection also takes a depthwise convolution path before the final residual.
2026-LSCA.caption_zh: 空间自注意力接到通道自注意力，其中值还经深度卷积分支，最后加上该阶段的输入。

2026-MCA.caption_en: Downsampled queries, keys, and a bridge form two channel weight matrices that mix full-resolution values in succession.
2026-MCA.caption_zh: 降采样后的查询、键和中间特征生成两张通道权重矩阵，依次混合全分辨率值。

2026-MCSA.caption_en: Multiscale pooling generates channel weights, and multiscale convolution on the gated features generates the spatial weights applied next.
2026-MCSA.caption_zh: 多尺度池化先生成通道权重，再对加权后的特征做多尺度卷积，生成空间权重并应用。

2026-MHLA.caption_en: Distance-weighted blocks exchange linear attention statistics, and the normalized query readout adds a local depthwise value projection.
2026-MHLA.caption_zh: 各块按距离混合线性注意力统计量，再将归一化的查询读出与局部深度卷积结果相加。

2026-MSEA.caption_en: Dense dilated context feeds channel and edge-aware spatial gates, then residual refinement returns features alongside the raw edge logits.
2026-MSEA.caption_zh: 密集空洞卷积提取上下文，随后施加通道与边缘感知空间门控，返回细化特征及边缘打分。

2026-MVP-VLM.caption_en: Visual tokens attend to each other and to the question, then per-token probabilities yield the sorted indices to keep.
2026-MVP-VLM.caption_zh: 视觉词元先做自注意力，再读取问题词元，随后按逐词元概率选出并排序保留索引。

2026-PAB.caption_en: Channel groups use different neighborhood sizes, then a pixelwise softmax selects their contributions to a projected weighted sum.
2026-PAB.caption_zh: 各通道组使用不同大小的注意力邻域，再按像素为各组分配权重，求和并投影。

2026-PartialAttention.caption_en: One channel slice runs self-attention with a residual, then rejoins the untouched slice in the original channel order.
2026-PartialAttention.caption_zh: 一部分通道做自注意力并加上残差，再按原通道顺序与旁路拼接。

2026-PAT-ch.caption_en: One channel half takes a spatial convolution, while mean and standard deviation gate the other half before concatenation.
2026-PAT-ch.caption_zh: 一半通道做空间卷积，另一半用均值和标准差生成门控，最后拼接两半。

2026-PAT-sf.caption_en: Relative image positions and scaled queries contribute to token scores, whose softmax weights mix values before restoring the image grid.
2026-PAT-sf.caption_zh: 相对图像位置与缩放后的查询一起影响位置打分，Softmax 权重混合值后恢复图像网格。

2026-PAT-sp.caption_en: A spatial gate scales one channel slice, while the other slice is normalized and projected before the two are concatenated.
2026-PAT-sp.caption_zh: 一部分通道由空间门控缩放，另一部分先归一化再投影，最后拼接两路。

2026-PoM.caption_en: Learned polynomials summarize context tokens, then a query-derived hard-sigmoid gate selects summary channels before the final projection.
2026-PoM.caption_zh: 可学习多项式汇总上下文词元，再用查询生成的 Hardsigmoid 门控选择通道并投影。

2026-PSAA.caption_en: Coarse context and wavelet detail gate two feature paths, then channel reweighting and parallel output convolutions fuse them.
2026-PSAA.caption_zh: 粗尺度上下文和小波细节分别生成两路门控，随后做通道重加权，并融合两路输出卷积。

2026-RELA.caption_en: Positive query and key features form normalized linear attention, and depthwise filtering of values supplies a local addition.
2026-RELA.caption_zh: 查询和键先映射为正值，再做归一化线性注意力，最后加上深度卷积处理后的值。

2026-SA-CA.caption_en: Spatially filtered queries and keys score channel pairs per head, then the value mixture is projected and added to the input.
2026-SA-CA.caption_zh: 带空间滤波的查询和键为每个头的通道对打分，再混合值、投影并加回输入。

2026-SAA.caption_en: Density-selected centers merge tokens into compact keys and values, which full-length queries read through softmax attention.
2026-SAA.caption_zh: 模块按密度选择中心并合并词元，生成紧凑的键和值，再由全长查询用 Softmax 注意力读取。

2026-SAM.caption_en: Two convolutional scales predict a spatially varying gate, which multiplies the input before the residual addition.
2026-SAM.caption_zh: 两路卷积尺度生成随位置变化的门控，用于缩放输入，再加回原特征。

2026-SAMC.caption_en: Sequential channel and spatial gates refine the input, then three convolutional scales are concatenated and projected.
2026-SAMC.caption_zh: 通道门控和空间门控依次重标定输入，再拼接三种卷积尺度的结果并投影。

2026-SCA-LRDUN.caption_en: A depthwise spatial filter gates pointwise values, and a convolutional feed-forward stage follows the first residual addition.
2026-SCA-LRDUN.caption_zh: 深度空间滤波生成门控并调制逐点投影后的值，残差相加后再接卷积前馈层。

2026-SCA-ParTY.caption_en: Self-attended tokens supply a shared query and two independent key–value projections, whose attention results fuse with residual connections.
2026-SCA-ParTY.caption_zh: 自注意力处理后的词元生成共享查询和两套独立的键值投影，两路注意力结果经残差连接后融合。

2026-SCFM.caption_en: Spatial and channel gates independently scale the input, then pointwise projections of the two gated paths are added.
2026-SCFM.caption_zh: 空间门控和通道门控分别缩放输入，两路结果各做逐点投影再相加。

2026-SDGW.caption_en: Local standard deviation yields a sigmoid gate that scales the features from a separate spatial convolution.
2026-SDGW.caption_zh: 局部标准差经 Sigmoid 生成门控，用于缩放另一条空间卷积分支的特征。

2026-SEA.caption_en: Channel attention mixes values, then a learned per-location transform of those values modulates the mixture before projection.
2026-SEA.caption_zh: 通道注意力先混合值，再用值的逐位置变换调制结果，最后投影。

2026-SFC.caption_en: Two receptive fields generate channel and spatial weights, which form a gate for projected features before the block adds its input.
2026-SFC.caption_zh: 两种感受野共同生成通道与空间权重，融合成门控并缩放投影特征，最后加回输入。

2026-SGILA.caption_en: Four channel statistics are summed into one spatial map, then convolution and sigmoid produce a gate for the input.
2026-SGILA.caption_zh: 四种通道统计量相加得到一张空间图，再经卷积和 Sigmoid 生成输入门控。

2026-SSC.caption_en: Windowed spatial and spectral correlations mix shared values in parallel, then the restored grids are concatenated, projected, and transposed.
2026-SSC.caption_zh: 窗口内的空间相关与光谱相关并行混合同一组值，随后还原网格、拼接、投影并交换空间轴。

2026-STAM.caption_en: Four channel groups take squeeze-and-excitation at different resolutions, then the fused maps modulate the full-resolution input.
2026-STAM.caption_zh: 四组通道分别在不同分辨率上做压缩激励，融合后的特征图再调制全分辨率输入。

2026-TAM.caption_en: Temporal attention mixes frames at each location, then a per-frame spatial gate and convolution fuse the result with the original frames.
2026-TAM.caption_zh: 时间注意力在每个位置混合各帧，再通过逐帧空间门控和卷积与原始帧融合。

2026-VHCA.caption_en: Two axis layouts score sequences of height and width, then their value mixtures are restored, summed, projected, and added to the input.
2026-VHCA.caption_zh: 模块按高、宽两种布局打分，将各自混合后的值恢复成网格，再求和、投影并加回输入。

2026-WeightFormer.caption_en: The block predicts depthwise kernels and a linear weight update for two residual stages that return the feature grid.
2026-WeightFormer.caption_zh: 模块预测深度卷积核与线性权重更新量，用于两次残差计算，然后还原特征网格。

2025-ACA.caption_en: The module pools rows and columns separately, predicts two coordinate gates, and scales the input by their broadcast sum.
2025-ACA.caption_zh: 模块沿两个坐标轴分别池化，生成两组门控权重。权重广播相加后乘回输入。

2025-Area-Attention.caption_en: Area-wise attention mixes projected values, then adds a depthwise position term from those values and projects the restored image.
2025-Area-Attention.caption_zh: 模块在各区域内用注意力混合值，再还原特征图，加上值分支的深度卷积位置项并投影。

2025-Attention-Ghost.caption_en: A Ghost expansion feeds a clamped channel gate, then a second Ghost transform projects the gated features and adds the shortcut.
2025-Attention-Ghost.caption_zh: 第一次 Ghost 变换扩展通道。截断门控重标定特征，第二次 Ghost 变换投影后与捷径相加。

2025-Attention4D.caption_en: Head mixing surrounds softmax on relative-position scores, and attended values are added to a depthwise value branch before projection.
2025-Attention4D.caption_zh: 模块在 Softmax 前后混合注意力头，并把加权结果与值的深度卷积分支相加后投影。

2025-CAM.caption_en: Within each image window, normalized query and key channels form a channel mixing matrix that weights values before the windows are reassembled.
2025-CAM.caption_zh: 模块在各窗口内用归一化查询与键计算通道权重，加权值，再拼回特征图。

2025-CeAtt.caption_en: The module samples the image, computes channel weights for each half, applies them to the opposite values, and upsamples the concatenated result.
2025-CeAtt.caption_zh: 模块先稀疏采样，再从两组通道分别计算权重并加权对侧的值，最后拼接并上采样。

2025-CEB.caption_en: Average and max pooling generate separate channel gates, then the module concatenates and shuffles the gated halves before adding the convolved input.
2025-CEB.caption_zh: 平均池化和最大池化分别生成通道权重。模块加权两半特征，拼接并随机打乱通道，再加回卷积特征。

2025-ConvAttn.caption_en: The input generates a depthwise kernel for selected channels, whose convolution is added to a supplied large-kernel result and rejoined with untouched channels.
2025-ConvAttn.caption_zh: 输入生成逐通道卷积核。模块将动态卷积与给定大核的结果相加，再拼回其余通道。

2025-CPIA-SA.caption_en: Sparse channel mixing and gated convolution exchange spatial and channel gates, then a frequency-domain depthwise transform refines their concatenated output.
2025-CPIA-SA.caption_zh: 稀疏通道注意力和卷积分支互换空间、通道门控。两路拼接后经频域深度卷积细化。

2025-CSA-ConvBlock.caption_en: Convolved queries and keys produce channel softmax gates that scale convolved values before residual addition and batch normalization.
2025-CSA-ConvBlock.caption_zh: 查询和键经卷积后生成每通道一个 Softmax 权重。模块加权值，再加残差并做归一化。

2025-CSAM.caption_en: Spatial affinity and inverted channel affinity reweight two parallel streams, and the module adds their independently residualized outputs.
2025-CSAM.caption_zh: 空间亲和与反向通道亲和分别加权两路特征。每路加上输入后，模块将两路相加。

2025-CSWin.caption_en: Each configured stripe applies softmax attention to its values, adds a depthwise positional term, and restores the token grid.
2025-CSWin.caption_zh: 模块在选定方向的条带内加权值，加上深度卷积位置项，再还原图像的令牌顺序。

2025-DCAFE.caption_en: Mean and max pooling generate separate height and width gates, and the module adds the two doubly gated copies of the input.
2025-DCAFE.caption_zh: 平均池化和最大池化各生成高、宽两组权重。模块分别乘回输入，再将两路结果相加。

2025-Deform-Interac-Att.caption_en: Channel mean and max maps can gate each other at half resolution before producing a spatial mask that scales the original features.
2025-Deform-Interac-Att.caption_zh: 通道均值图和最大值图可在半分辨率上互相门控，再生成空间掩码并乘回输入。

2025-DRPCA-DSA.caption_en: A kernel predicted per sample filters its channel mean map, and a sigmoid turns the response into a spatial gate for the input.
2025-DRPCA-DSA.caption_zh: 模块为每个样本生成卷积核，用它卷积通道均值图。Sigmoid 把响应变成空间权重，再乘回输入。

2025-DSAM.caption_en: A resized prediction gates foreground and background streams, which pass through separate atrous pyramids and fuse into enhanced features and a new prediction.
2025-DSAM.caption_zh: 模块缩放上一轮预测并生成前景和背景门控。两路各经空洞卷积金字塔，融合后输出特征和新预测。

2025-DSPM.caption_en: Standard and dilated convolutions fuse into one map, which is reweighted first by a channel gate and then by a spatial gate.
2025-DSPM.caption_zh: 普通卷积与空洞卷积的结果先融合，再依次经过通道加权和空间加权。

2025-DSSA.caption_en: Top-ranked regions restrict the search, then token-level top-k attention mixes selected values and adds a depthwise value term.
2025-DSSA.caption_zh: 模块先筛选区域，再在入选区域内筛选令牌并加权，最后加上值的深度卷积项。

2025-DSSA-UNet.caption_en: Pooled queries choose key regions, then finer token scores select values inside those regions before the module adds a local depthwise term.
2025-DSSA-UNet.caption_zh: 模块用池化查询选择键区域，再用区内令牌分数筛选并加权值，最后加上局部深度卷积项。

2025-Fuse-SE.caption_en: Spatial statistics and Fourier magnitudes produce channel logits, while average spatial deviation sets the temperature of the gate that rescales the input.
2025-Fuse-SE.caption_zh: 模块用空间统计量和频谱幅值生成通道分数，用平均空间标准差调节门控温度，再缩放输入。

2025-GA-Plenoptic.caption_en: Downsampled queries attend twice to the same full-resolution keys and values, then the result is upsampled and added to the original features.
2025-GA-Plenoptic.caption_zh: 低分辨率查询两次读取同一套全分辨率键和值。结果上采样后加回输入。

2025-GAG.caption_en: Grouped projections combine a gating map with a skip map, producing a one-channel sigmoid mask that scales the skip features.
2025-GAG.caption_zh: 分组卷积分别投影门控图和跳连特征。模块结合两路投影，生成单通道掩码并乘回跳连特征。

2025-GCA-Gauss.caption_en: Average and max pooling locate the strongest channel, which centers a Gaussian density whose batch-normalized values scale every input channel.
2025-GCA-Gauss.caption_zh: 全局均值和最大值之和选出响应最强的通道。以该通道为中心的高斯密度经批归一化后缩放输入。

2025-GLCA.caption_en: One channel half uses a global mixing matrix, the other uses a local convolutional gate, and their concatenation is added to the input.
2025-GLCA.caption_zh: 全局分支用通道矩阵混合一半特征，局部分支用一维卷积门控另一半。两路拼接后加回输入。

2025-HDPA.caption_en: Global channel weights guide a channel-max projection that predicts a local gate, and both gates multiply the original features.
2025-HDPA.caption_zh: 全局通道权重先引导通道最大池化，再生成局部门控。两组权重相乘后缩放输入。

2025-HMHA.caption_en: Correlation groups channels for attention, an optional prior cache modifies the weights, and a current cache gates the mixed features before projection.
2025-HMHA.caption_zh: 模块按相关性分组通道。可选的上一层缓存调节权重，本层缓存调节混合后的特征，再做投影。

2025-HPA.caption_en: Mean- and max-pooled coordinate paths exchange channel descriptors to produce a spatial gate for each group of input channels.
2025-HPA.caption_zh: 两路分别用均值和最大值生成坐标门控，再交换通道描述量打分，为各通道组生成空间权重。

2025-IIA.caption_en: Shared mean-and-max gating runs along the width and height axes, and both gated maps are restored and added to the input.
2025-IIA.caption_zh: 模块沿宽、高两轴分别用均值和最大值生成权重。两路加权图还原轴顺序后加回输入。

2025-InterSliceSA.caption_en: Projected voxels attend across slices along one chosen axis, and a learned sigmoid coefficient blends the restored volume with the original.
2025-InterSliceSA.caption_zh: 投影后的体素沿选定轴跨切片加权。结果还原为体积后，用可学习的系数与原输入混合。

2025-KSFA.caption_en: Two successive depthwise kernels supply features that a pooled branch selector combines into a sigmoid gate for the input.
2025-KSFA.caption_zh: 两级深度卷积提供不同感受野的特征。模块用池化结果选择并混合两路，再生成门控缩放输入。

2025-LP-DETR-RA.caption_en: Relation heads normalize exponentially weighted scores with supplied relation factors, while ordinary heads use softmax before rejoining for value mixing.
2025-LP-DETR-RA.caption_zh: 关系头用给定关系因子调整指数分数并归一化。普通头用 Softmax，两类权重汇合后加权值。

2025-LRSA.caption_en: Queries read keys and values pooled at several aspect-ratio-aware resolutions, and optional query pooling is reversed by bilinear resizing.
2025-LRSA.caption_zh: 查询读取按长宽比进行多尺度池化的键和值。若查询也经过池化，模块用双线性插值恢复原尺寸。

2025-LRSA-2.caption_en: Overlapping patches attend independently, then overlap-averaged reconstruction feeds a residual depthwise feed-forward block.
2025-LRSA-2.caption_zh: 模块在重叠图块内分别做注意力，按重叠次数还原特征图，再通过带深度卷积的残差前馈层。

2025-LSA.caption_en: Pixel unshuffle exposes mosaic positions for a periodic gate, while a separate global channel gate scales the result across spectral channels.
2025-LSA.caption_zh: 像素反重排把马赛克位置分到不同通道以生成周期门控，另一路全局通道门控再按光谱通道缩放结果。

2025-M-CBAM.caption_en: Each group builds a channel-and-spatial mask, promotes above-mean entries to one, then the combined mask scales the features before residual addition.
2025-M-CBAM.caption_zh: 每组依次做通道和空间加权。掩码中高于组内均值的值置为 1，再拼接掩码、缩放特征并加残差。

2025-MALA.caption_en: Positive queries and keys provide a magnitude correction for rotary linear attention, then a local value term and output gate refine the result.
2025-MALA.caption_zh: 正值查询和键为旋转线性注意力提供幅度修正。模块再加入值的局部项，使用输出门控并投影。

2025-MANO.caption_en: Shared patch attention processes each resolution, then the module upsamples and adds coarse responses back into finer maps.
2025-MANO.caption_zh: 各分辨率共用图块注意力。模块从粗到细上采样，把粗尺度响应逐级加到细尺度特征中。

2025-MaskAttn.caption_en: A cached binary key mask blocks scores before softmax, then the weighted values pass through a token residual and layer normalization.
2025-MaskAttn.caption_zh: 缓存的二值键掩码先屏蔽部分分数。值经 Softmax 加权后，模块加回令牌残差并做层归一化。

2025-MKIRA.caption_en: Channel and spatial gates precede multikernel depthwise filtering, whose branches are combined, shuffled, and projected through an optional residual.
2025-MKIRA.caption_zh: 模块先做通道和空间加权，再用多个深度卷积核提取特征。各路合并并打乱通道，投影后可加残差。

2025-MSAM.caption_en: Four aligned scale maps feed ten self and cross-scale pairs, whose row-wise channel attention is fused and added to a convolutional merge.
2025-MSAM.caption_zh: 四路对齐的尺度图组成十对。模块对每一对逐行做通道注意力，再融合结果并加上卷积融合分支。

2025-MSC.caption_en: Multiscale pooled context provides keys and values, and two sparse score masks produce outputs combined with learned coefficients.
2025-MSC.caption_zh: 上下文经过多尺度池化后提供键和值。两种稀疏掩码分别加权值，结果用可学习系数相加。

2025-MSLA.caption_en: Four channel groups use different depthwise kernels and one shared linear attention, then learned scale weights combine their outputs through a pointwise projection.
2025-MSLA.caption_zh: 四组通道各用不同深度卷积核，共用同一个线性注意力。各路乘以可学习系数后拼接，再做逐点投影。

2025-PGSSA.caption_en: Global spectral attention runs beside windowed spatial attention, whose pooled tokens select a spectral prompt that gates the local output before summation.
2025-PGSSA.caption_zh: 全局光谱注意力与窗口分支并行。窗口令牌经空间注意力后汇总并选择光谱提示，门控结果与全局分支相加。

2025-PnP-Nystra.caption_en: Pooled query and key landmarks factor the kernel, and an iterative pseudoinverse helps mix values with a separately propagated normalization column.
2025-PnP-Nystra.caption_zh: 模块池化查询与键得到地标，用核矩阵的迭代伪逆混合值，再用一同传递的全 1 列归一化。

2025-SA-SE.caption_en: The deep path expands receptive fields through serial depthwise filters, while the shallow path uses one filter, with a residual when widths match.
2025-SA-SE.caption_zh: 深层路径串联多个深度卷积扩大感受野，浅层只用一次。输入和输出通道数相同则加残差。

2025-SAM.caption_en: Window affinity weights mix values, then the block restores the grid, adds a gated convolutional residual, and returns the attention weights.
2025-SAM.caption_zh: 窗口亲和权重混合值。模块还原网格并加上门控卷积残差，同时返回注意力权重。

2025-SBSAtt.caption_en: Fourier coefficients are sorted and packed into subbands, mixed by normalized channel scores, then returned to their original frequencies for inverse transformation.
2025-SBSAtt.caption_zh: 模块排序频率系数并打包成子带，用归一化的通道分数混合值，再恢复系数顺序并做逆变换。

2025-SCA-ConvBlock.caption_en: Each channel scores its own convolved query and key maps, and the resulting channel softmax scales values before the input is added back.
2025-SCA-ConvBlock.caption_zh: 每个通道用自己的卷积查询和键打分。模块在通道轴做 Softmax，加权值后加回输入。

2025-SCSA-StyleTransfer.caption_en: Semantic scores and top-one feature scores mix the same style values, then their weighted projections are added to the content image features.
2025-SCSA-StyleTransfer.caption_zh: 语义分数与特征最高分分别加权同一组风格值。两路投影经系数加权后加回内容特征。

2025-SSA-MaIR.caption_en: A channel shuffle lets grouped pointwise convolution compute gates over rearranged channels, then the inverse shuffle aligns those gates with the input.
2025-SSA-MaIR.caption_zh: 模块先打乱通道，使分组逐点卷积能用重排后的通道计算权重，再逆重排权重并乘回输入。

2025-TemAtt.caption_en: Spatial mean and max descriptors feed a temporal linear layer, which produces one sigmoid gate per step for residual scaling.
2025-TemAtt.caption_zh: 模块融合空间均值和最大值，再用时间线性层为每个时刻生成一个权重。加权结果加回原输入。

2025-TSFA.caption_en: The module folds channel groups into spatial tokens, retains a fraction of scores per query, and mixes values before restoring the feature map.
2025-TSFA.caption_zh: 模块把空间位置和通道组组成令牌，对每个查询只保留一定比例的键，再加权值并还原特征图。

2025-VolSA.caption_en: Spatial window weights generate a gate for the channel-attended stream, and the module adds both streams and their gated interaction.
2025-VolSA.caption_zh: 窗口空间权重生成门控，用来缩放通道注意力分支。模块把两路特征和门控结果相加。

2024-ASSA.caption_en: Blend softmax and squared ReLU weights from window scores, then use the blend to mix values and project the window tokens.
2024-ASSA.caption_zh: 把窗口得分分别送入 Softmax 和平方 ReLU，混合两组权重，再汇聚值向量并投影。

2024-CGA-DEANet.caption_en: Sum two feature maps, combine spatial and channel cues into a pixel gate, then project the gated blend and its residual sum.
2024-CGA-DEANet.caption_zh: 先将两张特征图相加，再合成空间和通道线索，生成逐像素门控，最后把加权结果与原和相加并投影。

2024-CGLU.caption_en: Split projected tokens in two, use a depthwise convolution and GELU to form local gates, then multiply the other half and project.
2024-CGLU.caption_zh: 将投影后的令牌拆成两路，用深度卷积和 GELU 生成局部门控，再与另一路相乘并投影。

2024-CLAttention.caption_en: Build local importance weights with soft pooling and convolutions, resize them, and multiply the input by both the weights and a first-channel gate.
2024-CLAttention.caption_zh: 用软池化和卷积生成局部权重并放大，再结合首通道门控对输入逐点加权。

2024-CRAttention.caption_en: Full-resolution queries and pooled keys spend one channel per head on scoring, then the weights mix pooled values for each input token.
2024-CRAttention.caption_zh: 全分辨率查询与池化后的键每个头只用一维打分，再按权重为各输入位置汇聚池化值。

2024-DLKA.caption_en: Two deformable depthwise convolutions build spatial weights, then the block reweights projected features, projects again and adds the input.
2024-DLKA.caption_zh: 两层可变形深度卷积产生空间权重，对投影特征逐点加权，再投影并加回输入。

2024-FACT-CrossAttention.caption_en: Action queries gather frame values, then the module concatenates the resulting context with the original action tokens and projects each one.
2024-FACT-CrossAttention.caption_zh: 动作令牌生成查询并汇聚帧值，再把所得上下文与原动作令牌拼接并投影。

2024-FCA-Dehaze.caption_en: Two projections of pooled channels yield reciprocal interaction scores, which the module blends and filters into channel weights for the input.
2024-FCA-Dehaze.caption_zh: 将池化通道的两种投影做双向交互，混合并滤波得到通道权重，再用它缩放输入。

2024-GAAM.caption_en: Split an axis into heads, normalize products of Gaussian densities within each head, then reweight the chunks and add the input back.
2024-GAAM.caption_zh: 沿指定轴分头，在每头内将高斯密度的乘积归一化并缩放输入块，再拼回并加上原输入。

2024-GRSA.caption_en: Residual projections within two channel groups form window queries, keys and values, then position-biased cosine attention mixes the values before groupwise projection.
2024-GRSA.caption_zh: 两组通道分别做残差投影来生成窗口查询、键和值，再用带位置偏置的余弦注意力汇聚值，最后逐组投影。

2024-LSKNet.caption_en: Pool paired receptive-field features to learn two spatial gates, then blend the gated features into a map that scales the input.
2024-LSKNet.caption_zh: 从两种感受野的特征中池化得到两个空间门控，再把加权特征合成一张图，用它缩放输入。

2024-MaSA.caption_en: Rotated queries and keys score width and height axes with distance decay, then two successive mixes and a depthwise convolution residual produce the output.
2024-MaSA.caption_zh: 旋转后的查询和键沿宽、高轴分别加入距离衰减打分，依次两次汇聚，再加上深度卷积分支并投影。

2024-MASAG.caption_en: Local and pooled cues choose two spatial weights, then cross-gated interactions create a mask that reweights and projects the first input.
2024-MASAG.caption_zh: 局部卷积与通道池化产生两组空间权重，再用交叉门控生成掩码，对第一路输入加权并投影。

2024-MSPA.caption_en: Process channel groups with cascading convolutions, pool each group at two scales, and normalize their weights across groups before reweighting and concatenating them.
2024-MSPA.caption_zh: 分组通道依次做级联卷积，各组做两种尺度的池化，再按组归一化权重并缩放、拼接各组特征。

2024-SCAM.caption_en: Pool channels and pixels in parallel, multiply a channel context by a spatial gate, then add the result to the input map.
2024-SCAM.caption_zh: 并行汇聚通道和空间信息，用空间门控调制通道上下文，再加回输入特征图。

2024-SSA-Strip.caption_en: Generate global strip weights for each channel group, filter horizontal and vertical neighborhoods in sequence, then combine the result with a learned input bypass.
2024-SSA-Strip.caption_zh: 按通道组生成条带权重，先后滤波横向和纵向邻域，再与带可学习缩放的输入旁路相加。

2023-AGCA.caption_en: Use pooled channels to build a sample-specific diagonal, add a learned adjacency matrix, and transform the graph output into channel scaling weights.
2023-AGCA.caption_zh: 用池化通道生成随输入变化的对角项，加上可学习的邻接矩阵，再把图聚合结果映射为通道缩放权重。

2023-CGA.caption_en: Each head attends to a channel slice plus the previous head’s output, then the module concatenates all head outputs and projects them.
2023-CGA.caption_zh: 每个注意力头处理一组输入通道，后续头还接收前一头的输出，最后拼接并投影各头输出。

2023-DRSformer-TKSA.caption_en: Keep four different fractions of channel scores, normalize each selection, and blend four weighted value maps with learned scalars before projecting.
2023-DRSformer-TKSA.caption_zh: 按四种比例保留通道得分，各自归一化并汇聚值，再用可学习标量混合四路结果并投影。

2023-ESSAttn.caption_en: Center and square projected queries and keys, form a compact key–value product, then apply queries and add the original values before projecting.
2023-ESSAttn.caption_zh: 查询和键先去均值再平方，接着先汇总键和值，再用查询读取并加回原值，最后投影。

2023-GOAT-Graph-Transformer.caption_en: Node queries attend to stored centroids with a log count bias, then gather centroid values while training updates the stored assignments.
2023-GOAT-Graph-Transformer.caption_zh: 节点查询加入簇大小的对数偏置后汇聚质心值，并在训练时更新节点分配和质心。

2023-LSGAttention.caption_en: Learn weighted token summaries, score those tokens with a Gaussian grid bias, then mix token values and project the result.
2023-LSGAttention.caption_zh: 先对输入做可学习的令牌汇聚，再加入高斯网格偏置打分，汇聚值令牌并投影。

2023-MCA.caption_en: Build sigmoid gates for height, width and optionally channels from pooled statistics, then average their separately reweighted feature maps.
2023-MCA.caption_zh: 用池化统计量生成高、宽以及可选的通道门控，再平均各路分别加权后的特征图。

2023-MLCA.caption_en: Pool into a local grid and a global vector, filter both into channel weights, blend at grid resolution and resize to scale the input.
2023-MLCA.caption_zh: 把输入池化为局部网格和全局向量，各自卷积生成通道权重，在网格上混合后放大并缩放输入。

2023-QuadrangleAttention.caption_en: Predict a projective grid per head and window, sample keys and values there, then let regular-window queries mix the sampled values.
2023-QuadrangleAttention.caption_zh: 逐头逐窗预测投影变换后的网格，在新网格采样键和值，再用规则窗口里的查询汇聚采样值。

2023-SwiftFormer-EAA.caption_en: Summarize normalized queries with learned token weights, multiply the summary into each key, then add the original queries and project.
2023-SwiftFormer-EAA.caption_zh: 用可学习的令牌权重汇总归一化查询，再与各位置的键逐点相乘，加回原查询后投影。

2022-ACmix.caption_en: Shared projections feed local attention and grouped convolution in parallel, then two learned scalars mix the feature maps.
2022-ACmix.caption_zh: 共享投影同时供给局部注意力和分组卷积，再用两个可学习标量混合两路特征。

2022-DAT.caption_en: Queries predict group offsets for sampling the input, then attend to keys and values projected from those samples before adding local position features.
2022-DAT.caption_zh: 查询预测各组采样偏移，再对采样特征投影出的键和值做注意力，最后加上局部位置特征。

2022-MDTA.caption_en: Project features with pointwise and depthwise convolutions, score channel pairs from spatially normalized queries and keys, then mix values and project.
2022-MDTA.caption_zh: 用逐点卷积和深度卷积生成查询、键和值，按空间轴归一化查询和键后做通道打分，再汇聚值并投影。

2022-PCAA.caption_en: Build local and global class centers from patch activations, then let pixels score local centers and read global values before residual fusion.
2022-PCAA.caption_zh: 从分块激活图提取局部和全局类别中心，让像素对局部中心打分、读取全局值，再加回原特征。

2021-NLSA.caption_en: Hash and sort matching features, attend within neighboring chunks, then restore pixel order and blend hash rounds before adding the residual.
2021-NLSA.caption_zh: 对匹配特征哈希并排序，在相邻分块内做注意力，再复原像素顺序、混合多轮结果并加回输入。

2021-SimAM.caption_en: Measure each activation’s squared deviation relative to its channel variance, pass the score through a sigmoid and use it to scale the activation.
2021-SimAM.caption_zh: 用通道内方差衡量每个激活值的平方偏差，再经 Sigmoid 生成逐点权重并缩放原特征。

2021-TiedSE.caption_en: Pool channel groups, apply the same excitation network to every group, then restore the channel layout and scale the input.
2021-TiedSE.caption_zh: 对通道做全局均值池化，各组共用同一套激励网络，再恢复通道布局并缩放输入。

2020-GCNet.caption_en: Learn one set of spatial weights for global pooling, then transform and add the resulting channel context at every input position.
2020-GCNet.caption_zh: 用一组空间权重把特征汇聚成全局通道上下文，再变换上下文并加到输入的每个位置。

2020-ImageGPT-Causal-Pixel-Attention.caption_en: Pixel queries score current and cached keys with a causal mask, mix values, and return projected tokens and the current key–value cache.
2020-ImageGPT-Causal-Pixel-Attention.caption_zh: 像素查询在因果掩码下对当前及历史键打分并汇聚值，返回投影后的令牌与本次缓存。

2019-ASTGCN.caption_en: Score pairs of graph nodes and time steps from the same input, then apply temporal weights to the history and return both weight maps.
2019-ASTGCN.caption_zh: 同一输入分别生成节点对和时间步对的权重，再用时间权重重组历史特征，并返回两张权重图。

2019-SAN-SOCA.caption_en: Compute channel covariance and its matrix square root, average the columns, then learn a sigmoid weight for each input channel.
2019-SAN-SOCA.caption_zh: 计算通道协方差及其矩阵平方根，取列均值，再经激励网络生成输入各通道的缩放权重。

2018-PSANet.caption_en: Collect and distribute features with two densely indexed pointwise masks, then concatenate their outputs and fuse them with the original map.
2018-PSANet.caption_zh: 用两张逐点掩码分别收集和分发特征，再拼接两路输出并与原特征图融合。

2016-DNC.caption_en: Controller gates select write slots, update memory and temporal links, then mix content and link-based weights to read words from memory.
2016-DNC.caption_zh: 控制器生成写入门和读出模式，更新记忆与时序链接，再混合内容和链接权重，从记忆读出向量。

na-BAM.caption_en: Add channel and spatial logits, pass the sum through a sigmoid, then scale the input by one plus the resulting gate.
na-BAM.caption_zh: 把通道和空间得分相加，再经 Sigmoid 得到门控，用门控加一后缩放输入。

na-DiffAttn.caption_en: Subtract a learned multiple of one causal attention map from the other, then mix shared values and normalize before output projection.
na-DiffAttn.caption_zh: 将一组因果注意力权重乘上可学习系数，再从另一组减去它，用所得权重汇聚共享值，归一化后投影。

na-LSKA.caption_en: Run horizontal and vertical depthwise filters at two scales, then use a pointwise projection of the result to scale the input.
na-LSKA.caption_zh: 先后做两组横向和纵向深度卷积，再将结果逐点投影，用所得权重缩放输入。

na-RGA.caption_en: Pairwise spatial relations generate a spatial gate, then channel relations from the spatially gated map generate a second gate.
na-RGA.caption_zh: 先用位置对关系生成空间门控，再从加权后的特征计算通道对关系，生成第二道门控。

na-SBA.caption_en: Compute a gate for each input, update the low-level map first, then use it to update the high-level map before resizing and fusing.
na-SBA.caption_zh: 两路输入各自生成门控，先更新浅层特征，再用它更新深层特征，最后对齐尺寸并融合。

2024-CamoFormer-MSA.caption_en: Use foreground, background and unmasked query–key paths, then concatenate their channel-attention outputs and fuse them with a convolution.
2024-CamoFormer-MSA.caption_zh: 三路分别用前景、背景和无掩码的查询与键做通道注意力，再将各路输出拼接并卷积融合。

2024-LEGM.caption_en: Fuse image, local and depth features in the first stage, then combine position-biased window attention with a depthwise value convolution.
2024-LEGM.caption_zh: 首层先融合图像、局部和深度特征，再把带位置偏置的窗口注意力结果与值的深度卷积分支相加。

2024-RegionalAttention.caption_en: For each pixel, score a dilated neighborhood with relative position bias, mix neighboring values, then project back to the pixel grid.
2024-RegionalAttention.caption_zh: 每个位置对扩张邻域内的键打分并加入相对位置偏置，再汇聚邻域值并投影回像素网格。

na-GAM.caption_en: Generate channel gains from a per-position MLP, then derive a spatial sigmoid gate from the scaled features and apply it.
na-GAM.caption_zh: 逐位置用 MLP 生成通道增益，再由缩放后的特征生成空间门控并逐点相乘。

na-GENet.caption_en: Gather local context with average pooling, resize it to the feature grid, then apply sigmoid weights to scale the input.
na-GENet.caption_zh: 在局部范围内做平均池化来汇总上下文，将其放大到原网格，再经 Sigmoid 生成缩放权重。

2018-AGNN-Cosine-Graph-Attention.caption_en: Scaled cosine scores weight source nodes after normalization over incoming edges, and each destination sums its weighted messages.
2018-AGNN-Cosine-Graph-Attention.caption_zh: 对入边的余弦分数做归一化，再加权求和源节点特征，得到各目标节点的输出。

2019-HetGNN-Neighbor-Type-Attention.caption_en: Bidirectional LSTMs encode node contents and same-type neighbors, then type weights blend the three neighbor summaries with the center node.
2019-HetGNN-Neighbor-Type-Attention.caption_zh: 双向 LSTM 编码节点内容和同类邻居，再按类型权重融合三路邻居摘要与中心节点。

2021-ABCNet-Attention.caption_en: Pointwise projections form normalized queries and keys, then spatial key and value totals produce a normalized response at each pixel.
2021-ABCNet-Attention.caption_zh: 逐点投影生成归一化查询与键，再汇总空间位置的键和值，为每个像素计算归一化响应。

2021-AlphaFold2-Triangle-Attention.caption_en: Pair features supply queries, keys, values, and a third-edge bias for masked row or column attention, with a sigmoid gate on the result.
2021-AlphaFold2-Triangle-Attention.caption_zh: 成对特征生成查询、键、值和三角第三边的偏置，按行或列计算带掩码的注意力，再用 Sigmoid 门控。

2021-SepFormer-Dual-Path-Attention.caption_en: Overlapping speech chunks attend within chunks and then across chunks at matching offsets before overlap-add restores the sequence.
2021-SepFormer-Dual-Path-Attention.caption_zh: 把语音序列切成重叠块，先在块内做注意力，再跨块比较相同偏移处的帧，最后重叠相加。

2022-ABC.caption_en: Token controls compress projected keys and values into a fixed number of slots, and each query reads a softmax-weighted mixture of slot values.
2022-ABC.caption_zh: 用令牌控制量把键和值压缩到固定数量的槽，再用每个查询对槽做 Softmax 并读取槽值。

2022-Dehamer-Attention.caption_en: A hazy image supplies dark-channel position codes for feature tokens, which mix within windows that alternate between regular and shifted partitions.
2022-Dehamer-Attention.caption_zh: 从雾图提取暗通道位置编码，加到特征令牌上，再交替用普通窗口和移位窗口混合特征。

2022-GeoTransformer-Geometric-Structure-.caption_en: Point distances and neighbor angles add a geometric term to feature scores before self-attention mixes values within each point cloud.
2022-GeoTransformer-Geometric-Structure-.caption_zh: 把点间距离和邻居夹角编码成几何项，加到特征打分上，再在同一点云内加权混合。

2022-RVRT-Guided-Deformable-Attention.caption_en: Flow plus learned offsets sample keys and values from a nearby clip, and query scores select how to mix the sampled values.
2022-RVRT-Guided-Deformable-Attention.caption_zh: 光流与学习得到的偏移共同定位邻近片段中的键和值，再用查询分数加权混合采样值。

2022-Stripformer-Strip-Attention.caption_en: Horizontal and vertical strip tokens attend along their respective axes, then restore the grid and fuse channels with a residual connection.
2022-Stripformer-Strip-Attention.caption_zh: 横向和纵向条带令牌分别沿各自的轴做注意力，再恢复网格、拼接通道并加回输入。

2022-TTVSR-Trajectory-Aware-Attention.caption_en: Trajectory locations sample past features, then the best cosine match picks one time step per patch and scales the fused features.
2022-TTVSR-Trajectory-Aware-Attention.caption_zh: 沿轨迹采样历史特征，用余弦相似度为每个图块选一个时刻，再按最高分缩放融合特征。

2022-UNetFormer-GLTB.caption_en: Window attention and directional pooling collect wider context, then a convolution branch adds local detail before separable projection.
2022-UNetFormer-GLTB.caption_zh: 用窗口注意力和沿轴池化汇聚较大范围的上下文，再合入局部卷积分支并做可分离卷积。

2022-ViTDet-Window-Propagation-Attention.caption_en: A window block mixes nearby patches first, then a global block spreads information across windows using height and width relative positions.
2022-ViTDet-Window-Propagation-Attention.caption_zh: 先在窗口内混合邻近图块，再用带高宽相对位置项的全局注意力把信息传到其他窗口。

2023-CASCADE-Attention-Gate.caption_en: Decoder gating features and skip features form a shared sigmoid mask that multiplies the original skip features at each spatial position.
2023-CASCADE-Attention-Gate.caption_zh: 把解码门控特征与跳连特征合成一张 Sigmoid 掩码，再逐位置乘回原始跳连特征。

2023-Co-DETR-Decoder-Auxiliary-Query-Mas.caption_en: Positive assignments become auxiliary decoder queries, with zero padding masked across all heads or sampled background queries filling the remaining slots.
2023-Co-DETR-Decoder-Auxiliary-Query-Mas.caption_zh: 把正样本分配整理成辅助解码查询。空位可补零并对所有头屏蔽，也可填入抽样的背景查询。

2023-CTformer-Dilated-Token-Attention.caption_en: Patch tokens mix twice with a dilated unfolding between rounds, then a final unfolding and projection return tokens alongside two skips.
2023-CTformer-Dilated-Token-Attention.caption_zh: 图像块令牌做两次注意力，中间用膨胀展开取样，最后再次展开并投影，连同两级跳连令牌返回。

2023-NGswin-N-Gram-Window-Attention.caption_en: Neighboring window summaries attend in both directions, then their merged context updates patch tokens before a second attention pass within each window.
2023-NGswin-N-Gram-Window-Attention.caption_zh: 双向聚合邻窗摘要，把合并后的上下文加到每个窗口的令牌上，再做窗口内注意力。

2023-PIP-Prior-Prompt-Interaction.caption_en: A degradation label selects a prompt that modulates image features, and a learned restoration prompt reads those features through channel cross-attention.
2023-PIP-Prior-Prompt-Interaction.caption_zh: 退化标签选择提示并调制图像特征，再由可学习的复原提示通过通道交叉注意力读取这些特征。

2023-SigLIP-MAP-Head.caption_en: A learned query pools image tokens through multi-head attention, then a residual MLP refines the resulting image vector.
2023-SigLIP-MAP-Head.caption_zh: 用一条可学习查询对图像令牌做多头注意力池化，再用残差 MLP 更新得到的图像向量。

2023-SRFormer-Permuted-SA.caption_en: Each full-resolution query attends to keys and values that pack four neighboring positions into one token, then the window output keeps the full grid.
2023-SRFormer-Permuted-SA.caption_zh: 把相邻四个位置的键和值重排成一个令牌，让完整窗口的每个查询都从压缩后的键和值读取。

2024-AlphaFold3-Atom-Cross-Attention.caption_en: Local atom queries gather keys from indexed subsets, mix values using pair-biased scores, then apply single-conditioned gates and a residual transition.
2024-AlphaFold3-Atom-Cross-Attention.caption_zh: 局部原子查询按索引收集键，用含成对偏置的分数加权混合值，再经过单原子条件门控和残差变换。

2024-ClearCLIP-Self-Self-Attention.caption_en: The same query projection supplies both sides of the similarity matrix, whose softmax weights mix projected values into output tokens.
2024-ClearCLIP-Self-Self-Attention.caption_zh: 用同一查询投影计算相似度矩阵，再用 Softmax 权重混合投影后的值，得到输出令牌。

2024-HiT-SR-Spatial-Channel-Correlation.caption_en: Each window correlates queries and values across compressed spatial positions and across channels, then restores the grid and fuses both results.
2024-HiT-SR-Spatial-Channel-Correlation.caption_zh: 窗口内的查询和值分别在压缩空间位置和通道上计算相关性，再恢复网格并融合两路结果。

2024-Right-chunk-Decoder-Only-ASR.caption_en: Speech and text lengths and chunk IDs determine which earlier keys each decoder token can see and how its position is numbered.
2024-Right-chunk-Decoder-Only-ASR.caption_zh: 根据语音和文本长度及分块编号，确定每个解码令牌可见的键，并生成位置编号。

2024-RT-DETRv2-Discrete-Sampling-Attenti.caption_en: Queries predict sample locations and weights, then integer lookup gathers values from feature levels and a weighted sum updates each query.
2024-RT-DETRv2-Discrete-Sampling-Attenti.caption_zh: 查询预测采样位置和权重，再用整数坐标从多尺度特征取值，按权重求和以更新查询。

2024-Simul-Whisper-Alignment-Attention.caption_en: Selected decoder attention heads are standardized, smoothed and averaged to align each token to audio and pick the last token’s strongest frame.
2024-Simul-Whisper-Alignment-Attention.caption_zh: 选取解码器注意力头，做标准化、平滑和平均，得到令牌到音频的对齐，并选出末令牌的最高分帧。

2024-StyleID-Style-Injection-Attention.caption_en: Content and current queries blend before scaled attention reads style keys and values and projects the resulting features.
2024-StyleID-Style-Injection-Attention.caption_zh: 先混合内容查询和当前查询，再用缩放打分读取风格键和值，并投影得到输出特征。

2024-VRT-Temporal-Mutual-Attention.caption_en: Each two-frame window mixes all tokens by self-attention, then joins that result with both directions of cross-frame attention.
2024-VRT-Temporal-Mutual-Attention.caption_zh: 双帧窗口对全部令牌做自注意力，再与两个方向的跨帧注意力结果拼接。

2024-X-Restormer-Cross-Scope-Attention.caption_en: Channel attention first mixes feature channels, then spatial queries read larger overlapping neighborhoods and return a refined feature map.
2024-X-Restormer-Cross-Scope-Attention.caption_zh: 先做通道注意力，再让空间查询读取范围更大的重叠邻域，得到更新后的特征图。

2025-AdaIR-Frequency-Mining-Attention.caption_en: An adaptive FFT split yields low and high features that read decoder values, gate each other, and feed a final cross-attention update.
2025-AdaIR-Frequency-Mining-Attention.caption_zh: 用自适应频谱掩码分出高低频。两路各自读取解码特征并相互门控，再做一次交叉注意力更新。

2025-DFAT-Dual-Focus-Attention.caption_en: Global match confidence and local neighbor similarity select spots whose pooled neighborhoods serve as keys and values for cross-attention.
2025-DFAT-Dual-Focus-Attention.caption_zh: 把全局匹配置信度和局部邻居相似度结合起来选点，再把选中点的邻域均值用作交叉注意力的键和值。

2025-EoMT-Masked-Query-Attention.caption_en: Learned queries join patch tokens, predict segmentation masks, and use those masks to restrict query-to-patch attention in the final encoder blocks.
2025-EoMT-Masked-Query-Attention.caption_zh: 把可学习查询接到图块令牌前，用预测掩码限制查询可见的图块，再在编码器末段更新令牌。

2025-LYT-Net-Luminance-Denoising-Attenti.caption_en: Luminance features become spatial tokens whose multi-head attention mixes values across positions before restoring the feature map.
2025-LYT-Net-Luminance-Denoising-Attenti.caption_zh: 把亮度特征整理成空间令牌，通过多头注意力混合各位置的值，再恢复成特征图。

2025-TabPFNv2-Row-Column-Attention.caption_en: Within-row attention mixes feature groups, then attention down each column reads training rows before a residual MLP updates the table.
2025-TabPFNv2-Row-Column-Attention.caption_zh: 先在每行内混合各特征组，再沿每列读取训练行，最后用残差 MLP 更新整张表。

2026-GRAPE.caption_en: Token features steer causal attention through cumulative query–key rotations or a distance penalty gated by each key, then heads merge into output tokens.
2026-GRAPE.caption_zh: 用令牌特征控制因果注意力。一路按累积相位旋转查询和键，另一路按键调节距离惩罚，最后合并注意力头。

2018-SHAN-Hierarchical-Session-Attention.caption_en: User-conditioned weights pool the entire history, then pool that summary together with recent items to produce one session vector.
2018-SHAN-Hierarchical-Session-Attention.caption_zh: 用户向量先给整段历史加权，再给历史摘要和最近物品加权，得到会话向量。

2019-FDSA-Item-Feature-Dual-Attention.caption_en: Pool each item's attributes, encode items and pooled attributes in separate causal streams, then fuse their last valid states.
2019-FDSA-Item-Feature-Dual-Attention.caption_zh: 先对每件物品的属性加权，再分别编码物品和属性序列，融合两路最后一个非填充位置。

2019-GCSAN-Graph-Contextualized-Attentio.caption_en: Graph message passing builds the session sequence, then causal self-attention refines it and the two last valid states are blended.
2019-GCSAN-Graph-Contextualized-Attentio.caption_zh: 图消息传递先生成会话序列，因果自注意力再更新序列，最后混合两路的末尾非填充状态。

2020-DIFM-Field-Wise-Attention.caption_en: Field self-attention and a dense network each predict field factors, which are added and multiplied into the original embeddings.
2020-DIFM-Field-Wise-Attention.caption_zh: 字段自注意力和全连接网络各自估计字段权重，再把两组权重相加并乘回原嵌入。

2020-InterHAt-Hierarchical-Feature-Atten.caption_en: Three attention pools summarize progressively reweighted fields, then a second Softmax weights those three summaries into one vector.
2020-InterHAt-Hierarchical-Feature-Atten.caption_zh: 三次注意力池化依次汇总重标定的字段，再给三个汇总向量加权，得到一个向量。

2020-LESSR-Shortcut-Graph-Attention.caption_en: Directed shortcut edges score source queries against destination keys, then normalize incoming weights and sum the corresponding source values.
2020-LESSR-Shortcut-Graph-Attention.caption_zh: 捷径边用起点查询和终点键打分，按终点归一化入边权重，再求起点值的加权和。

2020-STANet-Pyramid-Spatiotemporal-Atten.caption_en: Within corresponding windows from two times, attention mixes both feature maps before the pyramid outputs are concatenated and projected.
2020-STANet-Pyramid-Spatiotemporal-Atten.caption_zh: 注意力在两个时相的对应窗口内混合特征，再拼接各尺度结果并投影。

2021-RoseTTAFold-Three-Track-Attention.caption_en: Alignment attention informs pair features, which then guide alignment updates alongside attention constrained by residue distances.
2021-RoseTTAFold-Three-Track-Attention.caption_zh: 多序列比对的注意力图参与更新成对特征，成对特征和残基距离再引导比对更新。

2022-DC-Swin-Shared-Spatial-and-Channel-.caption_en: Spatial and channel branches use different linear contractions to reweight features, then each returns a scaled residual at its own resolution.
2022-DC-Swin-Shared-Spatial-and-Channel-.caption_zh: 空间和通道注意力沿不同的轴计算线性加权，再把缩放后的结果加回各自的输入。

2022-MedFormer-Bidirectional-Attention.caption_en: Voxel and semantic-map queries share one score matrix, whose two Softmax axes let each side aggregate values from the other.
2022-MedFormer-Bidirectional-Attention.caption_zh: 体素和语义图共用一张打分矩阵，沿两个轴分别归一化，再各自汇集对方的值。

2023-ESMFold-Pair-Biased-Sequence-Attent.caption_en: Pair features bias masked sequence attention, then gated sequence updates supply products and differences that refine the pair features.
2023-ESMFold-Pair-Biased-Sequence-Attent.caption_zh: 成对特征给带掩码的序列注意力加偏置，更新后的序列再用乘积和差值更新成对特征。

2023-RoseTTAFold2-MSA-Pair-Attention.caption_en: Pair and distance features bias row attention, column attention mixes alignment sequences, and averaged outer products update the pair features.
2023-RoseTTAFold2-MSA-Pair-Attention.caption_zh: 成对和距离特征给行注意力加偏置，列注意力混合比对序列，平均外积回写成对特征。

2024-BiFA-Bitemporal-Interaction-Attenti.caption_en: Queries from the first time score channels from the second time, whose values are mixed and projected back into the first stream.
2024-BiFA-Bitemporal-Interaction-Attenti.caption_zh: 第一个时相的查询给第二个时相的通道打分，混合其值，再投影回第一个时相。

2024-KVQuant.caption_en: The cache packs inliers, stores outliers and the first token separately, then reconstructs keys and values for rotary causal attention.
2024-KVQuant.caption_zh: 缓存打包范围内的值，另存异常值和首词元，再重建键和值以计算旋转位置编码下的因果注意力。

2025-ACL-Restoration-Linear-Attention.caption_en: Positive query and key maps mix image tokens through a compact key-value product, while depthwise position terms and a SiLU gate shape the output.
2025-ACL-Restoration-Linear-Attention.caption_zh: 正值查询和键通过紧凑的键值乘积混合图像词元，深度卷积位置项和 SiLU 门共同调节输出。

2025-GPT-OSS-Attention-Sinks.caption_en: Each head adds a learned logit to the masked Softmax, drops that probability, and mixes only the real token values.
2025-GPT-OSS-Attention-Sinks.caption_zh: 每个头在带掩码的 Softmax 中加入一个学习得到的分数，舍去对应权重，再混合实际词元的值。

2025-MiniMax-M1-Hybrid-Attention.caption_en: A decayed linear layer mixes and gates token values, then a full-attention layer applies rotary grouped-query attention to the result.
2025-MiniMax-M1-Hybrid-Attention.caption_zh: 线性注意力用衰减状态混合值并加门控，下一层对所得词元执行带旋转位置编码的分组查询注意力。

2025-ModernBERT-Alternating-Local-Attent.caption_en: Each layer uses its own rotary settings and a global or sliding-window bidirectional mask before mixing token values.
2025-ModernBERT-Alternating-Local-Attent.caption_zh: 各层按类型选择旋转位置编码和双向掩码，再用全局或滑窗注意力混合词元的值。

2025-TabDPT-In-Context-Row-Attention.caption_en: All rows query the context prefix, whose values also carry target embeddings, and gated attention returns a residual with SwiGLU.
2025-TabDPT-In-Context-Row-Attention.caption_zh: 所有行都查询上下文行，上下文的值还含目标嵌入，经门控注意力和 SwiGLU 得到残差。

2026-MSPT-Ball-Tree-Multiscale-Attention.caption_en: Ball-tree chunks share pooled tokens during local self-attention, then point outputs return to their original order and shared tokens are averaged.
2026-MSPT-Ball-Tree-Multiscale-Attention.caption_zh: 球树分块在各块的自注意力中共享池化词元，再恢复点的原顺序，并对共享词元取均值。

2026-TileSparse-Decode-Attention.caption_en: Page estimates select keys and query heads, then masked dot products and Softmax weight the values for each decoding query.
2026-TileSparse-Decode-Attention.caption_zh: 页分数决定保留哪些键页和查询头，再对加掩码的点积做 Softmax，并汇总对应的值。
